title: Love it

title: Helpful app
body: The lessons provided in the plan are incredibly helpful in breaking down my procrastination habits and identifying areas for improvement.

title: Awesome app ❤️
body: I don't generally leave reviews, but I feel this is one worth writing. I use the app more often than my book because it's more flexible, and it's nice to have equivalent macro options. This program is cheaper than similar programs I've used, and I actually lost 15 lbs in my first month - without exercise. I was skeptical, but it works!
